title: Aquatic Static

RAW: usually just a plain recording, with no effects whatsoever, except for when binaurals are specified.
SFX: with sound effects, like echoes, panning, 3D, environmental effects, and all sorts of fun stuff.

The second is SFX, with background layering and panning. Nothing too distracting to take away from the trance, but plenty for your mind to focus on and enjoy.

And the fourth used to be a Patreon exclusive, now public, which is a mastered version of the SFX track, with timely added binaural beats, music, and sound effects where needed. It’s a full auditory experience. Also comes with a long HFO-centered loop file based on Aquatic Static.
